locations.description: Access paths to the same content; the first is canonical. An absolute URL, or a path relative to the record file for a small metadata file committed beside it (README, agent guide, code list, thumbnail).

name.description: Asset name; must be unique across data[] and additional_assets[].

roles.description: Asset roles. Suggested values, not a closed set: `metadata`, `validation`, `describedby` (human documentation such as a README), `agents` (a Markdown guide for AI agents: keys and join columns, quirks, CRS consequences, tested queries), `thumbnail`, `overview`, `visual`, `example` (a code file: a runnable usage example, e.g. a notebook or SQL file).

orcid.description: ORCID iD of the named person.

examples: Alliance of Bioversity International and CIAT
International Center for Agricultural Research in the Dry Areas (ICARDA)
International Crops Research Institute for the Semi-Arid Tropics (ICRISAT)
International Maize and Wheat Improvement Center (CIMMYT)

roles.description: Roles this contact holds (one or more).

description.description: What this entry holds and how it differs from the record's other entries: which part of the dataset it covers (one table, region, or period), or which layout of the same data it is (e.g. time- vs space-optimized chunks) and when to use it.

checksum.description: Digest of the single file this entry names, as <algorithm>:<hex>. Not for templated or indexed entries; a cdh-inventory carries per-file checksums.

name.description: Asset name; must be unique across data[] and additional_assets[].

structures.description: Names of the structures[] this asset holds. Required on every asset when the record declares structures[]. Structure membership must be verified before publication.

href_template.description: Optional relative file-name pattern appended to each locations[].url. Each {token} must match a dimensions[].name or be the reserved {variable} token, which expands over variables[].name; the entry expands to one item per combination of the tokens' values. A token on a type: temporal dimension may carry a strftime format ({date:%Y.%m.%d}, directives %Y %m %d only) when the file name spells the date differently from the ISO value. When absent, locations[].url are full file URLs and the entry is a single asset.
href_template.$comment: Braces balance; a token is {name} or {name:format}, and a format holds at least one directive and no other %.

file_index.description: Indexes that list or open this entry's files as one dataset, per the File indexes section of standard.md. Each entry is one index file; its locations[] are the same file at several addresses. format names the specification the file follows. CDH does not open index files. Mutually exclusive with href_template.

format.description: Specification the index file follows: stac-geoparquet (STAC Items as GeoParquet), gti (GDAL Tile Index), vrt (GDAL Virtual Raster), kerchunk (kerchunk reference file), icechunk (Icechunk repository with virtual chunks), or cdh-inventory (CDH CSV file list of absolute URLs).

title.description: Optional label, e.g. which scheme the index's internal paths use.

media_type.description: IANA media type of the index file itself, when it has one. Optional; useful for gti (GeoPackage, FlatGeobuf, or Parquet).

spatial.description: Coverage of this asset alone, for selecting files by area. Same shapes as the top-level spatial. Omit when unknown; the top-level bbox is not copied down.

nodata.description: No-data / fill value for the asset.

processing_steps.description: ids of processing[] steps that produced this asset.

dataAsset.$comment: locations may be omitted when a file_index carries the file locations itself.

bboxCoords.description: A single bounding box: 2D [west, south, east, north], or 3D [west, south, min_z, east, north, max_z]. WGS84 (EPSG:4326); elevation in metres.

date.description: Date or date-time. Use YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. 2026-06-23) or an RFC 3339 date-time (e.g. 2026-06-23T00:00:00Z).

coverageDate.description: ISO 8601 date/time; the precision states the granularity - year (2020), month (2020-06), day (2020-06-23), or an instant (2020-06-23T00:00:00Z). As an end, it is inclusive through the end of that period (end: 2010 means through 2010-12-31).

id.description: Short, stable, URL-safe identifier (lowercase letters, digits, hyphens).

rel.description: Link relation type, e.g. cite-as or describedby.

locations.description: Access paths to the same content; the first is canonical. URLs are always absolute and machine-actionable: a data file, a store or directory prefix, or a service endpoint - never a landing page or DOI (those go in citation.url, doi, or additional_links).

title.description: Optional access label, e.g. HTTPS or S3.

url.description: Absolute URL. In additional_assets[] it may instead be a path relative to the record file.

fileSize.description: File size: whole bytes (31100000) or a number and unit (31.1 MB). Units are B, KB, MB, GB, TB, PB, in powers of 1000 (1 KB = 1000 bytes), rounded up to whole bytes.

mediaType.description: Media type (IANA), optionally with format parameters such as profile or version.

code.description: Software or code that produced this step's output. Omit when none is published.

url.description: Link to the production code or repository.

version.description: Version, tag, or commit of the code.

derived_from.description: Upstream sources this step derived from - the data (e.g. a Zenodo/Dataverse landing page), not code. Each entry has an id (a Hub record) or a url (anything else), not both.

id.description: id of the Hub record used. Must resolve to exactly one catalog record.

url.description: URL of a source outside the Hub.

version.description: Version label of the source release that was used, as the source publishes it.

id.description: Step identifier; one step must use id: source for the original generation.

orcid.description: ORCID iD of the person, as its https://orcid.org/ URL.

ror.description: ROR id of the organization, as its https://ror.org/ URL.

author.description: A citation author: either a person or an organization.

family.description: Family name(s). A person with a single name uses this field alone.

organization.description: Full name of an organization credited as an author.
examples: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations

title.description: Cite-as title; may differ from the record's top-level title.

authors.description: Authors in citation order. A person gives family (and usually given); an organization gives organization.

date.description: Publication date or year, e.g. 2024 or 2024-07-15.

publisher.description: Publisher or venue: the data publisher/repository for datasets, or the journal for articles.

label.description: Human-readable resolution, e.g. 5 arc-minutes or Kenya counties.

reference_system.description: For point/polygon types, the system defining the reporting units (e.g. GAUL 2015, GADM).

type.description: Resolution type: xy (regular grid), x, y, point, or polygon.

unit.description: Unit of measurement, preferably compliant with UDUNITS-2 or UCUM. Non-grid spatial units may use clear labels such as admin-level.

value.description: Numeric resolution value (grid spacing, or admin level).

bbox.description: Spatial extent. A single bounding box, or a list of boxes for disjoint coverage - each box is a real area covered, in any order; do not include an overall/union box. 2D = [west, south, east, north] = [xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax]; 3D = [west, south, min_z, east, north, max_z]. WGS84 (EPSG:4326); elevation in metres.

crs.description: Coordinate reference system of the data: EPSG code, CRS URI, or PROJ string.

geography.description: Named places for discovery (vocab/geography.json ids, UN M49).

geometry_column.description: Name of the geometry column, for vector tables.

resolution.description: Spatial resolution / spacing. Exactly one characterization per record: a single entry, or an `x` + `y` pair when grid spacing differs. A representation at a different resolution (e.g. polygon aggregates of a grid) is a separate record.

temporal.description: Coverage extent, precision-aware. Use `date` for a single instant or period (date: 2020 = the year 2020), or `start_date` + `end_date` for a span (end_date: null = open-ended). `date` and `start_date`/`end_date` are mutually exclusive. Temporal cadence is not recorded here - declare a type: temporal dimension instead.

date.description: A single instant or period; its precision sets the granularity (year, month, day, or datetime).

end_date.description: End of a span; null for an open-ended series.

update_frequency.description: How often this resource gains new data. Recommended while a series is still growing; omit for a finished one.

temporalValues.description: ISO 8601 strings, all at one precision: year, month, day, or an RFC 3339 date-time with seconds and offset.

description: JSON Schema for CDH metadata records. This validates structure, types, controlled values, and basic input rules; CDH review still handles contextual and curatorial checks.

access.description: Access condition for the resource's data, distinct from license. Omitting it means public. Aligned to the DCAT / EU accessRights vocabulary: public (openly accessible); restricted (discoverable, but obtaining the data requires a request or authentication); non-public (catalogued but not available through public channels).

access_note.description: Human-readable access conditions or instructions. Required when access is restricted or non-public; maps to schema.org conditionsOfAccess.

attribution.description: Credit line reusers should reproduce: wording a license or upstream source requires, or the credit the producer asks for. One short statement; do not restate citation. Maps to schema.org creditText.
examples: Contains modified Copernicus Emergency Management Service information [year]

additional_assets.description: Sidecar or auxiliary assets, e.g. metadata files or thumbnails.

additional_links.description: Related links: citation targets, services, or related resources.

cdh_schema_version.description: CDH standard version this record targets. Matches the release tag: v<MAJOR>.<MINOR>.<PATCH>.

contact.description: People or organizations responsible for the resource. At least one entry must hold the `licensor` role - the party that granted the license.

created.description: Date the metadata record was created - the record, not the data file.

data.description: Data assets for the resource; at least one entry.

deprecated.description: true when a newer release (same id) supersedes this record.

description.description: Canonical human- and AI-readable summary of the resource.

dimensions.description: Cube axes: domain axes (e.g. crop, scenario), a vertical axis (type: z), place-key columns (type: location), and temporal axes (each type: temporal with a step). The horizontal lat/lon grid is derived from the top-level spatial field and is not declared here.

name.description: Axis name. Must not be "variable": measures are not axes and belong in variables[]; href_template refers to them via the reserved {variable} token.

description.description: What the dimension is; define coded values here, or via reference_system or a sidecar.

type.description: Dimension type. Reserved values change how the dimension is read: `temporal` (an axis of ISO 8601 dates or instants - the only type that may carry a step, and a record may declare several, e.g. a year axis files are split on plus a day column inside them) and `z` (a vertical axis - depth, height, or pressure level - at most one per record). `location` names a column identifying a place, such as an admin or station code. Any other value names a domain axis after what it varies (crop, scenario, season). `spatial` and `geometry` are rejected: the horizontal grid is derived from the top-level spatial field and never declared here, and STAC forbids both words as custom dimension types. Lowercase; aliases of `temporal` are rejected so a time axis cannot silently become a domain axis.

reference_system.description: Vocabulary the dimension's values are coded against; prefer a resolvable URI when one exists (e.g. an AGROVOC concept scheme).

step.description: Spacing between consecutive values, as an ISO 8601 duration (P1Y, P3M, PT6H) with at least one nonzero component. Not the length of the period a value represents. Required with extent; omit on an irregular axis. Only valid on a type: temporal dimension.

extent.description: First and last value of a regular temporal axis, as ISO 8601 strings, in place of listing every value. Only valid on a type: temporal dimension with a step, and not alongside values. Both strings are written at one precision (YYYY, YYYY-MM, YYYY-MM-DD, or an RFC 3339 date-time with seconds and offset), no coarser than the step, start before end. The values are start, start + step, … while <= end, at that same precision, so ["1981", "2025"] with step P1Y is 1981, 1982, ... 2025.

unit.description: Unit of measurement for the values, preferably compliant with UDUNITS-2 or UCUM. Needed on a `z` dimension (m, cm, hPa) and useful on any numeric domain axis; not a substitute for reference_system, which names the vocabulary or vertical CRS the values are coded against.

values.description: On a temporal dimension, every value is an ISO 8601 date or an RFC 3339 date-time with seconds and offset, as a string. A value that labels a window is one date, such as its start; the dimension description gives the window length. A cyclic label axis (DJF/MAM/JJA/SON) is not temporal - name it after what it varies and describe the labels. All values share one precision.

extensions.description: Pinned URLs of the CDH extension schemas this record uses.

foreign_keys.description: Keys from this table to other catalogued datasets, after Frictionless Table Schema foreignKeys. Each entry pairs this record's key columns with the referenced dataset's columns, positionally.

fields.description: Key columns in this record; each must be a declared dimensions[]/variables[] name.

resource.description: The dataset referenced (e.g. a boundary/station record): its catalog record id, which must resolve to exactly one catalog record, or an absolute URI for a dataset outside the catalog.

asset.description: The data[].name of the referenced dataset's file that holds reference.fields. Required when that dataset has more than one data[] entry.

fields.description: Matching columns in the referenced dataset, paired positionally with fields (same length).

keywords.description: Free-text search terms. Each item is either a plain string, or an object linking the term to an external vocabulary/ontology (e.g., AGROVOC, GEMET).

scheme.description: Resolvable URI of the controlled vocabulary or ontology this term comes from. CDH vocab schemes (.../cdh-metadata-standard/vocab/) belong to cdh.domain / commodities - link an external vocabulary instead.

uri.description: Resolvable URI of the specific concept within `scheme`.

license.description: License of the data as an SPDX license expression. Custom LicenseRef-* expressions must be accompanied by an additional_links[] entry with rel: license.

note.description: Caveats, warnings, or interpretation-critical remarks not captured in description.

parent.description: id of the parent record, when this record is a child representation of it. Omit on top-level records. Must resolve to exactly one catalog record, must not equal this record's id, and must not create a parent cycle.

previous_version.description: version of the predecessor record (same id), when this supersedes an earlier release.

processing.description: Ordered processing/provenance steps; at least one must have id: source.

related_publications.description: Related works such as papers or reports.

resource_type.description: Kind of resource the record describes (vocab/resource_type.json).

series.description: Program, initiative, or product brand the resource was published under (e.g. Africa Agriculture Adaptation Atlas, MapSPAM, ACASA). Members may span domains, resolutions, and resource types. Not for grouping representations or releases of a single resource. `name` is the grouping key - use the same spelling on every record in the series; `url` is the series landing page.

structures.description: Layouts for records whose assets hold different dimensions and variables. Each structure groups variables that share dimensions: every variable in it has every one of its dimensions. With structures, every data[] entry names the structures it holds. Without structures, every variable has every declared dimension.

name.description: Structure name, unique within structures[]; data[].structures refers to it.

dimensions.description: Names of the dimensions[] every variable here has. Empty when the variables have no dimensions beyond the horizontal grid.

variables.description: Names of the variables[] in this structure.

updated.description: Date the metadata record was last updated - the record, not the data file.

description.description: Stable definition and reading guidance for the variable.

data_type.description: Data type of the stored values. Numeric names follow STAC raster:data_type; the rest cover table columns. other is for nested types (list, map, struct).

unit.description: Unit of measurement, preferably compliant with UDUNITS-2 or UCUM. Required for measurements; omit for text or code columns.

nodata.description: No-data / fill value for this variable, where it differs from the asset's. Takes precedence over the asset's nodata for this variable only.

categories.description: Coded values of a categorical or classified variable and what each means. For long lists, link a sidecar with rel=describedby instead.

value.description: The coded value as stored in the data.

label.description: Short human-readable name of the category.

version.description: Version label of this release of the resource. The source's own label when it has one; otherwise a counter from 1. Letters, digits, dots, underscores, and hyphens only, since it becomes part of a superseded release's id. Not compared or sorted - order comes from previous_version.

allOf.$comment: With structures, every data[] entry names the structures it holds.
{variable} expands over variables[].name, so a template using it needs declared variables.

title: Climate Data Hub Metadata Input Schema
